category_title: EFL children with learning difficulties exhibiting behavioral disengagement and low motivation
scenario_title: Initial storytelling session with physical books
minimal_context: The student is participating in a group storytelling session where they are expected to listen to a physical storybook being read and act it out.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright everyone, please gather around. I am going to hold this storybook and read it to you, and I want you to listen and act it out with me.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why do we have to be away from our classroom? I want to return to my own classroom to do the homework I was supposed to finish.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to stay here for the story right now. Let's begin reading.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I simply do not like English, no matter what you do.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's just give it a try. Look at the book while I read and act out this first part.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Completely ignores the storyteller and starts playing with a pencil and strips of paper) This story is boring! (Stands up and starts running around the room)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Alright everyone, please gather around. I am going to hold this storybook and read it to you, and I want you to listen and act it out with me.

STUDENT: Why do we have to be away from our classroom? I want to return to my own classroom to do the homework I was supposed to finish.

TUTOR: We need to stay here for the story right now. Let's begin reading.

STUDENT: I simply do not like English, no matter what you do.

TUTOR: Let's just give it a try. Look at the book while I read and act out this first part.

STUDENT: (Completely ignores the storyteller and starts playing with a pencil and strips of paper) This story is boring! (Stands up and starts running around the room)

task.content: Listening to a story being read and acting out the story

context.materials: Physical storybook, pencil, strips of papers, power point slides, big screen, white board

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When storytellers held the book and acted out the story at the same time
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Pupils often ran around the room or fought with others... completely ignored the storytellers and played whatever they had brought with them, even a pencil, or strips of papers.
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Complained about the boredom of the stories and wanted to return to their own classrooms to do the homework

behavior_patterns.condition: When storytellers attempted to engage them in English activities
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Told the storytellers that they simply did not like English, no matter what storytellers did.
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Did not know why they had to be away from their classrooms
